paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with CAST-CAPP
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: CAST-CAPP haloscope excludes axion-photon coupling for virialized galactic axions over 19.74-22.47 ueV (4.774-5.434 GHz). Best sensitivity g_agamma = 8e-14 GeV^-1 at 90% CL. Only the best value and mass range are given numerically in text; the detailed exclusion curve is in Fig.5 (not extractable from text). Data points here represent the approximate best-limit level spanning the scanned mass range.
